items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Story Of The Blues by Paul Oliver. That book? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Worked over in Paris month or two...was with a big rock 'n' roll show over there. Had a bunch o' strange people I never saw before. They was all a-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-oll'-timers, played music back like in that book you got.
The Story Of The Blues by Paul Oliver. That book?
Yeah. I played with a bunch o' them I had never seen before.
